lineage.strategy: Use the newly added primary SEC leadership-transition filing to refine, rather than inflate, governance/execution risk: distinguish observed senior-capacity change from unproven commercial deterioration and define a falsifiable monitoring path.

claims.claim: The senior Business Development & Strategy transition is an observed capacity/governance change, but the filing simultaneously names continuity of business-development leadership; it therefore supports monitoring risk rather than a present finding of pipeline deterioration.

affectedFactors.name: governancePower
affectedFactors.basis: A senior executive moved to part-time strategic work while an existing VP continues leading business development.

affectedFactors.name: executionMonitoring
affectedFactors.basis: Commercial continuity has a named owner, but reduced senior strategic capacity creates a testable transition variable.

causalEdges.mechanism: role transition can alter strategic bandwidth and relationship continuity
existing leadership continuity can reduce handoff disruption

risks.risk: Reduced time commitment from a senior strategy/business-development executive may increase transition/key-person execution risk.

unknowns.unknown: Whether the transition changes customer acquisition, design-win conversion, strategic initiative cadence or organizational capacity is not disclosed.
unknowns.nextEvidencePath: Compare subsequent primary-source design-win/pipeline disclosures and management commentary against pre-transition cadence; do not infer impact from the personnel event alone.

falsifiers.condition: Subsequent primary disclosures show stable or improving design-win conversion/commercial execution with no attributable disruption after the transition.
falsifiers.effect: Weakens the hypothesis that reduced senior strategic capacity created material execution risk.

falsifiers.condition: Subsequent primary disclosures identify delayed/lost programs or commercial disruption attributable to the leadership transition.

recommendation: Use as bounded risk-source support only. Preserve the distinction between an observed role transition and an unobserved commercial outcome; Alpha retains numeric underwriting authority.
